# The Banking Academy

> Executive education platform delivering AI-powered banking transformation through immersive bootcamps, global study tours, and specialized training programs for financial leaders across Asia, Africa, and beyond.

The Banking Academy specializes in executive education for banking professionals, with a strong focus on AI integration, digital transformation, and financial innovation. The platform offers flagship programs including the Building The AI Bank Bootcamps, international study tours to innovation hubs like Shanghai and Silicon Valley, and customized in-house training for financial institutions.

## Key Topics

- AI Strategy
- Digital Transformation
- Banking Leadership
- Executive Education
- AI Bootcamps
- Study Tours
- Fintech Innovation
- Risk Management
- Financial Services
- Generative AI
- Shanghai International AI Finance Summit
- Banking Transformation
- Professional Development
- Leadership Development
- Agentic AI

## Flagship Programs

- [Building The AI Bank Bootcamps](https://thebankingacademy.com/building-the-ai-bank-bootcamps): Immersive AI banking executive education program across Asia and Middle East regions
- [Building The AI Bank Bootcamps Asia 2026](https://thebankingacademy.com/building-the-ai-bank-bootcamps/asia-2026): Executive AI banking bootcamp in Kuala Lumpur for digital transformation and innovation
- [Building The AI Bank Bootcamps Africa 2026](https://thebankingacademy.com/building-the-ai-bank-bootcamps/mea-2026): AI banking bootcamp in Cape Town covering digital transformation and financial leadership
- [The Banking Olympiad](https://thebankingacademy.com/the-banking-olympiad): Simulation-based banking competition for executives in Manila, Bangkok and Philippines

## Global Innovation Study Tours

- [Shanghai AI Study Tour and Retreat](https://thebankingacademy.com/shanghai-ai-study-tour-and-retreat): Shanghai AI finance summit study tour for banking leadership on AI strategy and risk management
- [2026上海人工智能国际论坛周](https://thebankingacademy.com/shanghai-ai-study-tour-and-retreat-ch): Shanghai AI forum study tour covering fintech, digital payments and banking transformation
- [Silicon Valley AI Study Tour 2026](https://thebankingacademy.com/silicon-valley-ai-study-tour-2026): Silicon Valley AI immersion program for banking executives on cross-industry innovation insights
- [Beijing AI Study Tour 2026](https://thebankingacademy.com/beijing-ai-study-tour-2026): Beijing AI study tour on large-scale AI deployment and China's financial services innovation
- [Innovation Tours](https://thebankingacademy.com/innovation-tours): Global innovation study tours to Shanghai, Hangzhou and China for banking finance leadership

## Specialized Training Courses

- [Small Business Finance](https://thebankingacademy.com/small-business-finance): Training course on SME banking, lending, credit and risk management for financial intermediation
- [Impact Investing](https://thebankingacademy.com/impact-investing): Impact investing training on ESG frameworks, sustainable investing and carbon markets
- [Inhouse Training](https://thebankingacademy.com/inhouse-training): Corporate in-house training for banking professionals on strategy, leadership and risk
- [Inhouse Digital Bank Strategy Workshop](https://thebankingacademy.com/inhouse-digital-bank-strategy-workshop): Digital banking strategy workshop covering fintech, AI and financial services transformation
